about: Every advisory npm audit reports for the mobile apps, classed by where the code runs (reviews of October 2026, M-11). build: tooling on the build machine (Metro, the Expo CLI, config plugins), never in the app; CI checks that no build-classed package appears in the bundles' source maps. runtime: shipped inside the app. scripts/mobile_advisories.py fails CI on a high or critical advisory missing here, on a runtime one at high or above unless accepted with a date, and on any entry past its review date. The upgrade that clears them: Expo SDK 58 (expo-router 58, Metro and the CLI with fixed micromatch, node-forge and uuid), once it is the stable SDK; until then the entries are reviewed at review_by.

advisories.where: micromatch in Metro's file map (metro-file-map, @expo/metro-file-map): the bundler's file watcher on the build machine
advisories.risk: a deeply nested brace pattern exhausts the stack of the bundler; patterns come from the project's own configuration, not from users
advisories.fix: Expo SDK 58 (Metro with micromatch on a fixed braces)

advisories.where: @expo/code-signing-certificates in the Expo CLI: signing of over-the-air updates, which these apps do not use (they ship only store builds)
advisories.risk: a forged RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature could pass verification in the CLI; the apps neither carry node-forge nor verify update signatures with it
advisories.fix: Expo SDK 58 (the CLI on node-forge 1.4.1 or later)

advisories.where: xcode in @expo/config-plugins: writing the iOS project during prebuild on the build machine
advisories.risk: a missing bounds check when a caller passes its own buffer; the config plugins never do

advisories.where: query-string in expo-router: parsing the query of a deep link opened in the app
advisories.risk: a malformed percent-encoded link makes the app spend time decoding it: the app on the one device that opened the link stalls; no data is exposed
advisories.fix: expo-router 58 (query-string on decode-uri-component 0.5); forcing 0.5 under query-string 7 breaks it (0.5 is an ES module, query-string 7 requires it)
advisories.accepted_by: mobile lead, 2026-10-10: moderate, device-local, until Expo SDK 58 is the stable SDK
